milestones.title: The hosted cryptography inventory lists the condition with an item for your organization's authorizing official

remediation: The hub image builds on a Debian base, which the hosted design does not accept at Protected B, and that base is not assessed for hosting. Rebase it on UBI 9 with the OpenSSL FIPS provider. Until then your organization's authorizing official decides whether to accept the condition.
title: The sync hub image is on a Debian base
